body.objective: Determine whether the Appendix-C Bateman--Turok squeezed vacuum is a vector in the ordinary positive topology of the stated Fock--Krein carrier when the infrared cutoff is removed, using an exact finite-box normalization and an independent pair-block implementability test.
body.current_gate: FOCK_KREIN_IMPLEMENTABILITY: classify the compatible positive fundamental symmetries, reconstruct the finite-box squeeze coefficient, and test both the first two-particle sector and the Bogoliubov pair block before removing the infrared cutoff.
body.stop_condition: Certify either a finite positive-topology squeezed-vacuum vector with an implementable pair block, or an exact obstruction on the ordinary Fock--Krein carrier with every extended, rigged, or non-Fock completion left explicitly open.
body.forbid: no indefinite null norm used as a positive-topology convergence test; no fixed infrared cutoff called the massless continuum; no inequivalent momentum-dependent fundamental symmetry silently substituted for the stated Fock topology; no ordinary-Fock obstruction promoted to failure of the algebraic homomorphism, Eq. (19) in an extended carrier, gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics
body.resource_hint: Work in a cubic box first. Keep the six-mode lowest shell explicit, separate total norm from norm density, and run all exact producers, verifiers, tests, and paper builds sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
